en.headline: Abby Choi murder trial opens at High Court
en.dek: The former husband, brother-in-law and father-in-law of the socialite face joint counts of murder and preventing lawful burial; proceedings began with preliminary legal argument.
body: The murder trial of three former relatives of socialite Abby Choi Tin-fung opened at the High Court on Monday, more than three years after her death drew intense public attention in Hong Kong.

Alex Kwong Kong-chi, her former husband; Anthony Kwong Kong-kit, her former brother-in-law; and Kwong Kau, her former father-in-law, each face one count of murder and one count of preventing the lawful burial of a corpse. Prosecutors allege the killing took place on 21 February 2023 and that the defendants prevented the lawful burial of her body between 21 and 23 February that year.

Deputy Judge Sir Brian Keith ordered that nothing said in the current legal procedure may be published until the trial ends. The ban applies to the media and everyone present in court. The hearing began with preliminary matters rather than jury selection, which is expected later in the week. Senior Counsel Charlotte Draycott appears for the prosecution; the three defendants are represented by barristers Trevor Beel, Oliver Davies and Andrew Raffell.

Crowds gathered early outside the High Court, with public seats filled in the main courtroom and an overflow extension used in the morning. By the afternoon the number of spectators had fallen to about 30. Choi’s father attended the morning session. The trial is expected to last around 45 days.

zh.headline: 蔡天鳳謀殺案開審 三名前姻親受審
zh.dek: 社交名媛蔡天鳳的前夫、前大伯及前家翁於高等法院開審，同被控謀殺及阻止合法埋葬屍體；今日先處理程序事宜。
body: 社交名媛蔡天鳳 Tin-fung 謀殺案周一於高等法院開審，三名前姻親被控謀殺及阻止合法埋葬屍體，案件距離事發已超過三年。
被告為蔡天鳳前夫鄺港智、前大伯鄺港傑及前家翁鄺球，各被控一項謀殺罪及一項阻止合法埋葬屍體罪。控方指謀殺於2023年2月21日發生，三名被告其後於2月21日至23日期間阻止合法埋葬遺體。
副法官 Sir Brian Keith 下令，現階段法律程序內容在審訊完結前不得報道，禁令適用於傳媒及所有在場人士。今日先處理程序事宜，陪審團遴選預計稍後進行。控方由資深大律師 Charlotte Draycott 代表，三名被告分別由大律師 Trevor Beel、Oliver Davies 及 Andrew Raffell 代表。
高等法院外清晨已有市民排隊，主法庭公眾席及大堂延伸法庭早上均座無虛席，下午旁聽人數減至約30人。蔡天鳳父親早上有到庭。審訊預計為期約45天。
